follow-up time: From admission for induction of labor until delivery
exposure: slow-release prostaglandin E2 vaginal insert for cervical ripening
cohort: 1285 women with singleton gestation who underwent induction of labor due to post-date pregnancy using a slow-release prostaglandin E2 vaginal insert for cervical ripening
finding: Women who achieved cervical ripening with prostaglandin E2 vaginal inserts were younger, more often multiparous, and had lower rates of intrapartum cesarean delivery and adverse outcomes compared to women who did not respond to ripening.
